description:
Look up information about any UK car, van, bike, lorry etc, with just the number plate!

e.g.

- "@AnyReg, look up WN67DSO"
- "@AnyReg, what year was WN67DSO sold?"
- "@AnyReg, is WN67DSO taxed?"
